name: iris_group_means
description: Mean of each numeric Iris column (sepal_length, sepal_width, petal_length, petal_width) per group, grouped by the `by` column (species: setosa, versicolor, virginica), rounded to 3 decimals, plus the row count per group. Computed with pandas from the CSV shipped with the group; pure, stateless, no side effects. The result carries an MCP App (iris_chart) that draws the means as an inline SVG bar chart in hosts that render apps; other clients get the JSON. Use it after iris_describe when the question is how the species differ.

by.description: the column to group by; only species is categorical
